flow.name: stock-queue-expiring-request
flow.doc:description: Queues a stock reservation request with an expiresAt for the message expiration consumer.

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 import try from dw::Runtime output application/java --- (payload is Object) and (not isEmpty(payload.orderId)) and (not isEmpty(payload.sku)) and (try(() -> payload.expiresAt as DateTime).success default false)

raise-error.doc:name: Raise BAD_REQUEST Error - Invalid request
raise-error.description: orderId, sku and an ISO date-time expiresAt are required

when.expression: #[(payload.quantity != null) and ((not (payload.quantity is Number)) or (payload.quantity <= 0) or ((payload.quantity mod 1) != 0))]

raise-error.doc:name: Raise BAD_REQUEST Error - Invalid quantity
raise-error.description: quantity must be a positive integer

os:store.doc:name: Queue Request
os:store.os:value: #[output application/java --- { orderId: payload.orderId, sku: payload.sku, quantity: payload.quantity default 1, expiresAt: payload.expiresAt, queuedAt: now() as String }]

set-payload.doc:name: Set Queued Response
set-payload.value: #[output application/json --- { orderId: payload.orderId, status: 'QUEUED', expiresAt: payload.expiresAt }]

flow.name: stock-consume-expiring-requests
flow.doc:description: Message expiration consumer: a Scheduler takes every queued request, reserves stock for the ones not yet expired and moves the expired ones aside with the reason; a request that fails is moved aside as FAILED and the run goes on.

os:store.doc:name: Move To Expired Requests
os:store.os:value: #[output application/java --- { orderId: payload.orderId, status: 'EXPIRED', expiresAt: payload.expiresAt, consumedAt: vars.vConsumedAt as String, reason: 'expired before it was consumed' }]

logger.doc:name: WARN: Log request expired
logger.message: #['Reservation request of order ' ++ payload.orderId ++ ' expired at ' ++ payload.expiresAt ++ ', not processed, correlationId=' ++ correlationId]

os:store.doc:name: Reserve Stock
os:store.os:value: #[output application/java --- { orderId: payload.orderId, status: 'RESERVED', sku: payload.sku, quantity: payload.quantity, expiresAt: payload.expiresAt, consumedAt: vars.vConsumedAt as String }]

on-error-continue.doc:name: On Error Continue (this request failed, the run goes on)

os:store.doc:name: Move To Failed Requests
os:store.os:value: #[output application/java --- { orderId: payload.orderId, status: 'FAILED', expiresAt: payload.expiresAt, reason: 'could not be consumed: ' ++ error.errorType.namespace ++ ':' ++ error.errorType.identifier }]

os:remove.doc:name: Take Failed Request Off The Queue

logger.doc:name: WARN: Log request failed
logger.message: #['Reservation request of order ' ++ payload.orderId ++ ' could not be consumed (' ++ error.errorType.identifier ++ '), moved aside, correlationId=' ++ correlationId]

flow.name: stock-get-expiring-request
flow.doc:description: GET /eip/stock/expiring-requests/{orderId}: QUEUED while waiting, then RESERVED, EXPIRED or FAILED; 404 when unknown.

set-payload.doc:name: Set Queued Status
set-payload.value: #[output application/json --- { orderId: vars.vOrderId, status: 'QUEUED', expiresAt: vars.vQueued.expiresAt }]
